$comment: WP7 示範專案（C0 決定）：new-project.sh 從範本帶進來的批次分流規則 R1～R5 已拿掉——它們是 Jetson（L4T、Ubuntu 24.04）的範例，作者只寫了角色、日期是範例日期，會把符合條件的列標成 exploitable／in_triage（R1～R5 的 set.state；不會進 accepted），等於沒有人審過的判定；示範專案沒有人審過這些規則。只留依產品證據判定的 K1、K2、U1（U1 是 Ubuntu 的規則，這個 Debian 系的映像用不到，留著不會生效）：它們只在 author 是具名的人時生效，這裡 author 仍是角色（專案負責人），所以目前不生效。原本的說明：Example bulk triage rules for a Jetson (L4T, Ubuntu 24.04) product. Not applied automatically: copy to <project>/CRA/Config/vex-rules.json, replace the top-level author (the default for every rule) with the project lead's name, and adjust each rule's date and reason. A rule may set its own author. The evidence rules K1, K2 and U1 set not_affected from product artifacts only; they apply only with a named author, so they do nothing until the author is filled in; then replace sha256:<image digest> in images with the digests of the images the rules were reviewed for (a named author with the placeholder left in is a format error), or write ["*"] deliberately for every image of the project. See tools/cra/README.md.
author: 專案負責人

rules.description: Kernel: the fix's code is not built into the product kernel
rules.reason: The kernel configuration check compares the fix's program files from the Linux kernel CNA record with the product kernel .config and Makefiles; when none of them is built, the vulnerable code is not in the product.

rules.description: Kernel: the fix only changes modules that are removed from the image or blocked from loading
rules.reason: The module map (scan/kernel-module-map.json) and the image's module list and modprobe configuration (CRA/Config/kernel-modules.json) show that the code cannot run on the product.

rules.description: Ubuntu package: Ubuntu marks this version not affected
rules.reason: The Ubuntu Security team's CVE Tracker marks the source package as not-affected in this release, and the installed source version has the same epoch and upstream version as the version in its note.
